items.label: N270
items.text: Goes from I-495 to Frederick County. Exit 22 — Old Hundred Rd is the last exit in MOCO.

items.label: S270
items.text: Goes from Frederick County to I-495. Exit 22 — Old Hundred Rd is the first exit in MOCO.

items.label: 270 Spur
items.text: Goes towards Montgomery Mall (Democracy Boulevard) and Fairfax County.

items.label: 270 continues
items.text: Continues towards Rockville Pike (355) and Prince George’s County.

items.label: GEO
items.text: GEO as N270 or S270, then TAB out and select your location from the list provided.

items.label: E370
items.text: Goes from Washingtonian Boulevard (the Rio Area) to I-200 (Shady Grove Metro).

items.label: W370
items.text: Goes from I-200 (Shady Grove Metro) to Sam Eig Highway.

items.label: GEO
items.text: GEO as E370 or W370, then TAB out and select your location from the list provided.

items.label: E200
items.text: Goes from I-370 or Shady Grove Metro to Prince George’s County.

items.label: W200
items.text: Goes from Prince George’s County to I-370 or Shady Grove Metro.

items.label: GEO
items.text: GEO as E200 or W200, then TAB out and select your location from the list provided.

items.label: Tunnel or deck over
items.text: If caller is in the tunnel or deck over, call will be treated as a Structure Fire.

items.label: IL495
items.text: Goes from Fairfax County to Prince George’s County. Exit 41 — Clara Barton Parkway is the first exit in MOCO. Exit 28 — New Hampshire Ave is the last exit in MOCO.

items.label: OL495
items.text: Goes from Prince George’s County to Fairfax County. Exit 28 — New Hampshire Ave is the first exit in MOCO. Exit 41 — Clara Barton Parkway is the last exit in MOCO.

items.label: GEO
items.text: GEO as IL495 or OL495, then TAB out and select your location from the list provided.

sections.heading: I-495 interchange with MacArthur Boulevard, Clara Barton Parkway and Cabin John Parkway

items.label: Parallel roads
items.text: MacArthur Boulevard and Clara Barton Parkway run parallel to each other.

items.label: Clara Barton connection
items.text: Clara Barton is connected to I-495 by Cabin John Parkway.

items.label: Cabin John connections
items.text: Cabin John Parkway only connects to Clara Barton Parkway and I-495; there are no other intersections.

items.label: GEO Cabin John
items.text: Type “CJ” in the Location Field, then TAB out and select your location (Northbound or Southbound) from the list provided.

items.label: GEO Clara Barton
items.text: Type “CB” in the Location Field, then TAB out and select your location from the list provided.

items.label: Incident location
items.text: This is for incidents which occur on a street which is located ON the bridge over an Interstate or under the bridge of an Interstate. The incident did not occur ON the Interstate.

items.label: GEO
items.text: For an overpass or underpass of a street with an Interstate (I-270, I-495, I-200, or I-370), type in the street name only and TAB out. Select the location that has the street name AT highway.

items.label: Example
items.text: New Hampshire Ave AT I495
